name: rhongomiant-spellshroud-lost-abilities-is-targetable
notes: Rhongomiant, Grove's Spire (clS3E0HrZL, EXALTED/NORM WARRIOR REGALIA/WEAPON): "Spellshroud (Objects with spellshroud can't be targeted by spells.)" -- the first, unconditional keyword; only its two [Mordred Bonus] clauses are conditional. Condition boundary: Spellshroud is a printed ability, so a Rhongomiant that has lost all abilities (NO_ABILITIES override, seeded in setup rather than produced by a real effect -- only indirect proof of the real loses-all-abilities path) is targetable again: player 2's Fracturize offers theirField-1 and choosing it succeeds.

rulesClauses: An object that loses all abilities loses Spellshroud and can be targeted by spells.
